box.axes: X front->rear, Y left->right (seen from the front), Z up; origin at the exterior front-left-bottom corner
box.three_js: three = (Y, Z, -X): a reflection, so flip triangle winding
box.transform: row-major 4x4, local (x, y, z, 1) column vector -> box; local z+ is the face seen when the outline is viewed as drawn

steps.text: Stand the drawer back and front panels upright.
Press the bottom panel on from below.
Glue the faceplate to the front.
Join the top panel and the shelf to the divider: slide the divider toward the rear until its tabs seat in the top panel and shelf slots.
Fit the right wall onto the frame from the right, with its two drawer guides already glued on.
Fit the rear wall from the rear.
Fit the left wall from the left, with its two drawer guides already glued on.
Fit the front wall from the front.
Turn the box over and press the bottom panel in from below.
Slide the lid into its slots from the front.
Slide both drawers in through the rear openings until the magnets catch.
